Hidden jewel of Vui Bien
Jan 2020
One of my friend introduced me to this bar, hidden inside the streets of Vui Bien, and I was shocked how the atmosphere is completely different compared to other bars on the main streets. It was quiet, cozy and comfortable with retro style decorations inside. 

The bartenders and staffs were kind and engaging as well as the owner. They asked me what I like to drink(I was going for gin that day) and recommended one of their signature cocktail - 'Apple of my Eyes'. Personally, I don't like too sweet cocktails but this one was on the spot! Also, they had whole collections of whiskys and wines other than cocktails. I'm not a big fan of whiskys that I didn't try that day, but the owner seemed very knowledgeable about them. So if you're a whisky lover, this is the place you should visit.

Hidden gem in the hustle and bustle of Bui Vien
Jul 2019 • Friends
When talking about Bui Vien, you often think about a noisy and not-so-classy street in the centre of vibrant HCM city. But once you enter this bar and get behind the red curtain, you will be separated from all the noises and totally forget that you’re in the middle of that famous Bui Vien. The atmosphere is chilling, the Korean owners and staffs are so great and welcome. The whiskey collection is attempting and challenging your curiosity, which has not failed my expectation so far. You also can order cocktails which includes every basic ones and some bar signatures, just by telling the bartenders what your preference is and they will take care the rest. They surprised me every times by different and own-creation drinks, which made every visits are memorable. Suitable for group gathering (in third floor), couples who want to get closer and intimated, by talking of course :), also loner who just want to get a chilling relaxing time after a tough working day (which is my case most of the time lol). One of my favorite bars in HCM indeed!!
